description: This Java class defines the 'Group' entity within the Fineract project, representing a group or center with properties like status, hierarchy, clients, staff, and related methods for management and validation.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Entity class representing a group or center with properties and methods for managing group lifecycle, hierarchy, clients, staff, and validation within the Fineract system.

methods.name: newGroup
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Group instance with specified parameters, defaulting to PENDING status unless active is true.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the group, setting status to ACTIVE and assigning activation date, with validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates group properties based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes.

methods.name: associateClients
methods.description: Associates a set of clients to the group, throwing exception if any client is already a member.

methods.name: disassociateClients
methods.description: Removes specified clients from the group, throwing exception if any client is not a member.

methods.name: generateHierarchy
methods.description: Generates the hierarchy string for the group and its children.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the group with a reason and date, changing status to CLOSED.

methods.name: hasActiveClients
methods.description: Checks if the group has any active clients.

methods.name: hasActiveGroups
methods.description: Checks if the group has any active subgroup members.

methods.name: isCenter
methods.description: Returns true if the group is a center based on its level.

methods.name: isGroup
methods.description: Returns true if the group is a subgroup based on its level.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the group is closed.
